description: This file defines the SerialPort class for jSSC (Java Simple Serial Connector), providing methods for serial port communication including opening/closing ports, setting parameters, reading/writing data, event handling, and line status management.

classes.name: SerialPort
classes.description: Main class providing serial port communication functionalities, including port control, data transfer, event handling, and line status management.

methods.name: getPortName
methods.description: Returns the name of the serial port.

methods.name: isOpened
methods.description: Checks if the serial port is open.

methods.name: openPort
methods.description: Opens the serial port, throws exception if it fails.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Configures port parameters such as baud rate, data bits, stop bits, and parity.

methods.name: purgePort
methods.description: Purges the input/output buffers based on provided flags.

methods.name: setEventsMask
methods.description: Sets the event mask to specify which port events to listen for.

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description: Registers an event listener for serial port events.

methods.name: removeEventListener
methods.description: Removes the registered event listener.

methods.name: closePort
methods.description: Closes the serial port.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Writes a byte array to the port.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the port.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads bytes from the port and converts to String.

methods.name: readHexString
methods.description: Reads bytes and converts to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: getInputBufferBytesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes available in input buffer.

methods.name: getLinesStatus
methods.description: Provides status of control lines (CTS, DSR, RING, RLSD).

methods.name: isCTS
methods.description: Checks CTS line status.

methods.name: isDSR
methods.description: Checks DSR line status.

methods.name: isRING
methods.description: Checks RING line status.

methods.name: isRLSD
methods.description: Checks RLSD line status.

methods.name: setRTS
methods.description: Sets the RTS line state.

methods.name: setDTR
methods.description: Sets the DTR line state.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string to the serial port.
